curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As his schemes escalate alongside his psychological unraveling, how far can his reckless manipulation take him before the facade fractures completely?
curatedMovie.description: In Jon S. Baird's crime comedy-drama Filth, an addicted, bigoted cop battling borderline personality disorder resorts to scheming and erratic hallucinations in an aggressive push to secure a professional promotion.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Grimly comic and psychologically heavy, offering an engaged, tense character study suited for solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: It offers a volatile blend of caustic humor and raw psychological strain, grounding its abrasive crime story in an uncompromising, fiercely unstable central character.
